raw_report_bytes: Task report/evidence originals are untouched. Every archived entry is checked by SHA256. Selected raw evidence blobs must equal working bytes.
product_line_endings: Product text uses existing Git LF attributes. Clean conversion is checked against staged blob; original working bytes remain in archive and source hashes. No source rewrite occurs.
local_only: Unselected task evidence paths are preserved inside archive but remain local at their original paths. Stage/commit receipts and process logs are local and may be removed by later cleanup. Existing 010 raw-evidence.zip remains its preserved original.
scope: No cache files, unrelated operator edits, engine files, old scratch or other memories are staged.
